description: This file defines data models and query parameters for options chains, including classes for querying options data and representing options data with various properties and methods, using Pydantic for data validation and serialization.

classes.name: OptionsChainsQueryParams
classes.description: Class for handling options chains query parameters, including symbol input validation and conversion to uppercase.

classes.name: OptionsChainsData
classes.description: Class representing options chains data with properties like expirations, strikes, greeks, and methods for filtering and analyzing options data.

methods.name: to_upper
methods.description: Validator method to convert the symbol string to uppercase before processing.

methods.name: model_serialize
methods.description: Method to serialize the data model into a list of dictionaries for output.
